GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out leaving the 250 metres, bumping with ASK ME MATE on three occasions. Laid out throughout the home straight. Fell approaching the winning post, resulting in rider Lacey Morrison being dislodged.

Shifted out on jumping, bumping with FANCY GARTER, which in turn shifted out hampering RASHFORD. Shifted out under riding over the concluding stages and nearing the 50 metres, bumped with FANCY GARTER.
Shifted out on jumping bumping with BABUSHKA MISS.

Raced greenly in the early part of the home straight. Passing the 250 metres, when struck with the whip, ducked out abruptly and made heavy contact with TAMBO’S SISTER, which became badly unbalanced and lost momentum. As a consequence, TAMBO’S SISTER was forced wider and into the running of EXTRA FREE, which was also badly unbalanced and lost momentum.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped best and Went Forward to 1.25 Lengths Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 1 length turning, kept going in Straight # led/solid win
Jumped Ok drove through to lead 1 length clear, pushed along a touch turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths clear and kept going strong to the line increasing margin # led/no danger
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr q'd re leading. Stated instructed to ride positive & from inside gate held out & led when no other runner showed intent. Trainer stated surprised to see mount lead but was reminded of obligations.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased back 7l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no run on
Jumped Well eased back 2 Lengths off, eased 3 Wide turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off all clear, found little and kept on one pace # had run/no dash
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 800m commenced to race keenly and was obliged to be steadied, commenced to overrace for some distance thereafter.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Caught 3 Wide No Cover Mid Field 3 Lengths 800m, despite Wide run kept grinding away last 200m and got very close on line # just missed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out under pressure over the final 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began evenly. Rolled fww & shared lead on rail until back 2 Lengths to 3rd on rail @ 800m. Tracked leaders on inside until Two Wide @ 500m. Pushed to quicken Two Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & outsprinted in last 200m. # One-paced.
Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to turn, Held Up home turn then Held Ground to the post. [Stewards: Travelled keenly middle stages.] # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, resulting in its rider becoming unbalanced. Travelled keenly in the middle stages.
